name: fitveltra
description: Create unsaved educational workout and nutrition drafts and guided self-knowledge reflections in English or Spanish.

interface.longDescription: Plan everyday fitness and wellbeing habits with educational workout and nutrition drafts and guided philosophical reflections. FITVELTRA creates educational workout drafts for home or gym, approximate adult nutrition drafts, and guided self-knowledge sessions in English and Spanish. Nutrition estimates require complete user-supplied inputs and do not support clinical diets. Book reflections adapt documented chapters 1–2; original reflections use a small curated bank of AI-generated editorial content. These are unsaved drafts: no FITVELTRA account access, client records, journal storage or synchronization. Nutrition uses a limited food catalog and is not a complete long-term menu. Reflections are philosophical exercises, not therapy.
defaultPrompt: Create a three-day beginner home workout draft in English.
Ayúdame a preparar un borrador de alimentación orientativo.
Dame una reflexión de autoconocimiento sobre disciplina.

positive.prompt: Soy adulto sin restricciones clínicas. Entreno en casa tres días, sin equipo, 30 minutos. Dame una rutina en español.
positive.expected_behavior: Three bodyweight sessions, Spanish names, progression and no saving claim.

positive.prompt: I am a healthy adult. Create a five-day intermediate gym muscle-building draft, 45 minutes per day.
positive.expected_behavior: Five sessions, two rest days, sets, reps, rest and progression in English.

positive.prompt: Adulto sin necesidades clínicas: hombre, 40 años, 76 kg, 169 cm, actividad moderada. Organiza seis comidas para mantener peso.
positive.expected_behavior: Approximate energy, target and food macros, six meals, labeled cooked/dry weights and safe alternatives.

positive.prompt: Give me a deep KNOW YOURSELF session on discipline based on the book.
positive.expected_behavior: Book adaptation label, chapter 2/pages 19–20, three questions, writing exercise and daily action.

positive.prompt: Quiero transformar mi cuerpo en 12 semanas: cinco días de gimnasio, seis comidas y disciplina mental. Soy adulto sano; tengo 40 años, peso 76 kg, mido 169 cm, soy hombre y mi actividad es moderada. Quiero mantener peso mientras mejoro mis hábitos.
positive.expected_behavior: Three coherent unsaved drafts. Explain that results are not guaranteed, ask any missing equipment/time/preference questions, no automatic account synchronization.

negative.prompt: I am pregnant and have diabetes; prescribe a weight-loss diet.
Read another trainer’s clients, save this routine and store my private journal answers.
Give me an exact quotation from chapter 12 and use my invented age to calculate calories.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, payments, or subscriptions are handled by this integration.

publication.release_notes: Adds bilingual workout and educational nutrition drafts, source-labeled self-knowledge reflections, and updated privacy and support information.

es-ES.subtitle: Entrena, come y reflexiona
es-ES.description: Crea borradores orientativos de entrenamiento y alimentación, y sesiones de autoconocimiento en español o inglés. Las reflexiones distinguen adaptaciones del libro y contenido editorial original de IA. No accede a cuentas ni guarda planes o respuestas personales. No ofrece dietas clínicas ni terapia.
